title: Project Networks and Reallocation Externalities
eligible_reason: Not a staggered-adoption TWFE design. Table 4 estimates feols(winsorized_delay ~ treat_contractor | awarding_agency_code + recipient_duns + product_or_service_code) on coarsened-exact-matched samples with CEM weights, where treat_contractor (= rec_concurrent_storm_indicator) is a quarter-specific indicator that a major storm hit a county where the project's contractor has a concurrent project: a transitory shock that switches on and off, not an absorbing treatment. The regressions have no project (unit) FE and no calendar-quarter FE (quarter enters only as an exact-matching stratum), agency-node columns add a time-varying control (time to completion), and the delay-probability columns are logit. The package also ships only a random sample with scrambled DUNS for code validation, not the analysis data.
design_notes: Project-quarter panel (transactions.csv: 2.6M USAspending federal contracts 2011-2015 matched to NOAA storm events). Table 4: delay in days (winsorized) and delay indicator on treat_contractor / treat_awarding_office, six CEM granularities (MatchIt method='cem', matching on revenue, employees, offers, duration, budget, NAICS2, PSC2, price structure, quarter, state), FE agency + contractor DUNS + task code, cluster project, weights = CEM weights. Table 5: second-tier disruptions. Table 6: directly disrupted projects. Tables 7, 9: mechanisms on treatment-effect distribution. Figure 8: TE distribution.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not an adoption design; storm indicator varies quarter by quarter.
data_access_note: README: original USAspending and NOAA vintages (June/July 2019) overwritten and no longer available; Compustat licensed; only a random sample with scrambled DUNS is shipped, explicitly 'not to replicate the tables and figures'. Log PDFs from the original data are included.
data_files: sample_data/transactions.csv (442k rows; random sample, scrambled DUNS; code validation only)
screener_notes: Callaway-Sant'Anna is cited but not used. Treatment is a repeated transitory shock with CEM matching and no unit/time FE; excluded on design grounds and on data grounds.
